text: I wouldn’t expect any less from a challenger\nendorsed by the strongest Champion ever to\r\ngrace our beloved Galar region![VAR 0114(0006)]

I really do wish I could have seen the
Championship Match between you two.\c
And I’m terribly sorry to have ruined the whole
Gym Challenge and everything![VAR 0114(0006)]

It’s too bad, but it can’t be helped...\c
In order to solve the energy issue as soon as
possible, we awakened Eternatus. But we
couldn’t control it.\c
The Champion came to aid me, even at the cost
of abandoning the match.[VAR 0114(0006)]
Indeed, just like a knight in shining armor coming\nto rescue a princess from a dragon![VAR 0114(0006)]
I do tend to ramble on, I know.\nI love to make speeches.\r\nBut I think I can stop talking now.[VAR 0114(0006)]
I think the Champion should have captured\nEternatus by now.\c\nIf you’re curious, you can take the lift up.[VAR 0114(0006)]

And I trust you’ll be going too, right, Hop?
I certainly hope losing to me didn’t discourage
you too much.\c
Go on now, both of you! Go see how our
Champion is doing![VAR 0114(0006)]

Discouraged...?
You don’t get it, do you, Chairman?\c
Neither me nor my Pokémon are anywhere near
giving up!\c
We’ve learned how to be strong, thanks to the
Gym Challenge you organized![VAR 0114(0005)]
All right, [VAR 0100(0000)]?\nI’m ready for anything. Are you?[VAR 0114(0005)]
Wouldn’t expect any less from my rival!\nNow, come on! We’ve got to help Lee![VAR 0114(0005)]
Yeah, we’ve no idea what’s going on up there.\nBetter be sure you’re really ready![VAR 0114(0005)]
Of course I won’t stop you.\nHead up via the lift, if you wish![VAR 0114(0006)]
